drifted.spec_text: For locally-pinned memory, full CUDA unregistration is performed [on unpin].
drifted.actual: unpin_memory (src/lib.rs:227-245) only removes the pointer from the internal `pinned` HashSet; it never calls cudaHostUnregister or any CUDA unregistration API. pin_memory/unpin_memory do not distinguish 'IPC-imported' from 'locally-pinned' memory -- both are handled identically via HashSet bookkeeping on a GpuIpcHandle, which by construction (src/ipc.rs:70, GpuIpcHandle::new) is always IPC-derived. The 'locally-pinned memory / full CUDA unregistration' branch described in the spec has no corresponding implementation.

drifted.spec_text: Component MUST expose all functionality exclusively through the IGpuServices interface defined in components/interfaces.
drifted.actual: src/dma.rs exposes create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_gpu_bar, create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_phys, create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_bar_direct, and get_phys_addr as public free functions (p2p feature) that are not methods on IGpuServices. They are called directly by src/bin/p2p_server.rs (lines 21, 231) and tests/gpu_nvme_p2p.rs, bypassing the interface. This follows spec 002 FR-021/022/023 (which explicitly require standalone functions, not interface methods) but contradicts spec 001 FR-008 as written -- see conflicts.

drifted.spec_text: If cudaHostRegister succeeds but spdk_mem_register fails, the method MUST roll back by calling cudaHostUnregister before returning the error.
drifted.actual: register_host_memory (src/lib.rs:937-985) implements the rollback correctly, but additionally treats spdk_mem_register rc == -16 (EBUSY, 'already registered with SPDK') as success rather than an error, silently skipping the rollback path in that case. This special-casing is not documented in FR-015 or its Assumptions.

conflicts.description: Spec 001 FR-008 requires all component functionality to be exposed exclusively through the IGpuServices interface. Spec 002 FR-021/022/023 explicitly require create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_gpu_bar, create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_phys, and create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_bar_direct to be standalone functions (not IGpuServices methods). The implementation follows spec 002, which puts it in violation of spec 001 FR-008 as written. The two specs disagree on whether the P2P/GDRCopy DMA-buffer constructors belong on the interface.

components/gpu-services/CLAUDE.md describes the component as 'currently a skeleton -- initialize() and shutdown() lifecycle methods with an optional ILogger receptacle,' which is stale by roughly 22 functional requirements and ~3,700 lines of implementation across both specs (CUDA device discovery, IPC handle handling, pinning, DMA buffer creation, async streams, SPDK/GDRCopy P2P). Not a spec-vs-code drift, but a documentation-vs-code drift worth flagging.
